name: Shigmo Festival
description: Goan Hindu spring festival — colorful processions, folk dances (Ghode Modni, Fugdi), and community celebrations

name: Chavath (Ganesh Chaturthi)
description: Konkani Ganesh Chaturthi — grandly celebrated in Goa for 5 days with elaborate Ganesh idol immersions

name: Anant Chaturdashi
description: Anant Chaturdashi concludes Ganesh Chaturthi — grand Ganesh procession and visarjan (immersion)

name: Carnival of Goa
description: Pre-Lent Catholic-Portuguese festival with colorful floats and street parades — unique to Goa
